@graph.name: SuperchargeBrowser
@graph.description: Chrome extensions for tab suspension, ad blocking, vertical tabs, and workspaces. Zero telemetry, no SuperchargeBrowser servers. Featured & Verified Publisher on Chrome Web Store.

@graph.name: SuperchargePerformance
@graph.description: Tab suspender + ad blocker + RAM dashboard for Chrome. Suspends inactive tabs using chrome.tabs.discard(), blocks trackers with 186,000+ declarativeNetRequest rules from 22 sources. Zero telemetry, 100% local.
@graph.permissions: Zero telemetry. Zero outbound network requests. All data stored locally in chrome.storage.local.

@graph.name: SuperchargeNavigation
@graph.description: Vertical tabs + named workspaces + command bar + session time-travel for Chrome. Uses Chrome's side panel API. 50 auto-snapshots every 5 minutes. Alt+K command bar. Zero telemetry, local-by-default storage with opt-in cross-device workspace sync via Chrome's own storage.sync infrastructure.
featureList: Vertical tab sidebar (Chrome side panel API)
Custom new tab page with command palette
Alt+K command bar (tabs, bookmarks, history, web search)
Alt+G smart tab grouping by domain
Super Drag (drag links to open in bg/fg)
@graph.permissions: Zero telemetry. No SuperchargeBrowser servers. Local-by-default storage in chrome.storage.local; opt-in workspace sync via chrome.storage.sync (Chrome's own infrastructure, no SuperchargeBrowser involvement).
